text:
Aisha: Heads-up — spotted ~45% drop in API calls for Orbit Labs (acct 3209) over the last 7 days. Went from ~1.2M tokens/wk to ~650k. Also got a procurement ping yesterday about alternative vendors. Putting this on triage.
Brian: Oof. Any sign of stakeholder movement or procurement deadlines?
Aisha: Yes — their PM (Jordan) is new and has started a vendor eval this week. Also sandbox seats were reduced last month.
Jun: Can you share top routes/prompts and any recent errors? I can run a quick perf check (latency, 5xxs, model fallbacks). @Maya can you pull seat activity + billing anomaly?
Maya: Pulling last 30d now. Sharing quick dump: https://redwood.internal/insights/orbit/3209 (private link)
account-prod-bot: Alert: model_fallback_count increased to 18 in last 48h; avg token latency spike at 2025-11-09T14:12Z.
Aisha: Thanks — my ask: 1) Quick 30-min sync with Jordan + eng champion this week, 2) 1-pager comparing perf/cost vs their shortlisted vendor, 3) offer a focused enablement session for top 3 routes. Suggest we mark this as renewal-risk and do a targeted playbook.
Brian: I can reach out to Jordan now and propose times. Aisha — can you draft the 1-pager? Keep it TO-the-point: perf numbers, cost delta, and suggested short trial.
Jun: I'll prepare a 10-slide perf snapshot and include any regression traces. If they tried a competitor, call out infra tradeoffs (e.g., custom fine-tune infra, long cold-starts).
Maya: Quick stats (pulled):
```
- total_api_calls_30d: 240k (was 430k prior 30d)
- top_route_A: -62% calls
- avg_session_len: +18% (fewer sessions, deeper sessions)
- sandbox_seats_active: 6 (was 18)
- billing_anomaly: no obvious spike, costs down with usage
```
Aisha: Interesting — fewer sessions but longer ones. Could be batching or UI change on their side. Jun — flag if model fallbacks coincide with their session spikes.
Brian: Jordan replied — open to a quick call. They're interested in a perf report + a short workshop. Procurement person (Lina) wants cost breakdown. I'll include Lina on the invite.
Aisha: Scheduling provisional call Mon 9am PST; if not available propose Wed 11am PST. Action items: @Jun prepare perf deck, @Aisha draft 1-pager, @Maya attach seat/activity export, @Brian coordinate invite and procurement ask.
Jun: Will include a brief appendix on quantization impact and recommended batch/cache settings.
Maya: Export shared to thread and CRM. Tagging playbook: "engage-and-demo" in CRM.
Aisha: Good. I'll also propose a 2-week dedicated trial with a small reserved capacity (clear SLOs) as a mitigation if they want to test perf at scale.
Brian: Noted. I'll push procurement language and trial terms in the invite.
Aisha: Thanks team :thumbsup: Marking thread "monitoring" and creating follow-up reminder for Friday EOD to check pre-call readiness.
